prompt: The build output is stale. Remove the build and dist folders entirely, then recreate dist/ containing a copy of src/main.py.
setup: mkdir -p build/lib dist && printf x > build/lib/a.o && printf x > dist/app.tar
check: test ! -e build && test "$(ls dist)" = main.py && cmp -s dist/main.py src/main.py
solution: rm -rf build dist && mkdir dist && cp src/main.py dist/
